_meta.what: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code => (ISO 3166-2 sub-national code => state name in Arabic).
_meta.scope: Egypt only, all 27 governorates. The other 14 countries in states.json have no Arabic names yet and keep their English names in an ar install.
_meta.source: The 27 governorates of Egypt and their ISO 3166-2:EG codes, named with the short Arabic form an Egyptian address form shows (القاهرة, الجيزة, ...) rather than an official long form. Hand-written proper nouns, not generated: CLDR subdivision names are not in this ICU build (ResourceBundle::create('ar', 'ICUDATA-subdivisions') returns null) and there is no network path to CAPMAS from a build.
